monitoring.abort_condition: Abort on timeout, sustained lock wait, replication lag growth, unexpected disk/WAL growth, or a status-default verification mismatch.
monitoring.success_condition: Only additive identity registration relations exist; legacy accounts unchanged.

change_deployment_correlation.signal_or_method: deployment log records change/deployment correlation for the valuation/XIRR remediation

disk_growth.signal_or_method: relation and index disk growth during the migration window

lock_wait.signal_or_method: PostgreSQL lock wait duration for the migration statement

replication_lag.signal_or_method: replication lag before, during, and after the migration

retry_pause_abort_reason.signal_or_method: deployment log records retry, pause, or abort reason

rows_or_batches.reason: Paired-SQL additive DDL contains no financial-row population.

validation_mismatches.reason: The UNAVAILABLE status uses a constant default and no historical financial value is recalculated.

wal_growth.signal_or_method: WAL growth during the migration window

production_rollback.procedure: Disable registration, retain additive evidence; never restore unverified auto-activation.
production_rollback.verification: No new accounts may be created without ownership proof.

roll_forward.procedure: Apply additive identity tables, deploy compatible contract and frontend, enable approved mail worker.
roll_forward.verification: Ownership completion creates one account without session; legacy data unchanged.
